_doc: TEMPLATE ONLY. Copy to config.json and fill in. config.json is gitignored and must stay
that way — a Google Ads refresh token is a long-lived key to a manager account holding 49
google_ads — powers tools/fetch_search_volume.py, which runs MONTHLY (Google refreshes
Keyword Planner monthly; weekly polling just redraws the same number four times).
developer_token    apply at ads.google.com/aw/apicenter, signed in to the PPC Guru.ca
manager account. Needs a live company website and a monitored contact
address — a dead site is the usual rejection. Basic access is enough.
client_id/secret   an OAuth 2.0 Desktop client in Google Cloud, Google Ads API enabled.
refresh_token      one-time consent with access_type=offline on that client.
login_customer_id  the MCC itself. Digits only, no dashes.
customer_id        the account the request bills against; the MCC is fine.
bandsintown_app_id — free, granted on accepting their terms. Strong for music, THIN FOR
COMEDY: a blank result means 'not found on Bandsintown', never 'does not tour abroad'.
apify_token — lets tools/fetch_listings.py render BOOKMYSHOW itself. BookMyShow refuses
plain requests (403) but serves the same schema.org JSON-LD once a browser loads it on an
Indian IP, so Apify supplies only the browser and the IP; the same local parser reads it.
Get it at console.apify.com -> Settings -> Integrations -> API token. Without it BookMyShow
is simply skipped and the free sources still run.
